# Reunion Hackathon

> A 48-hour hackathon in Warsaw, 5–7 February 2027, for 100 Polish students and recent graduates of universities abroad. Theme: AI transformation. Free to take part, with selection by application. Organised by Global Polish Student Society (GPSS).

- Dates: 5–7 February 2027. Friday 16:00 registration, 17:00 opening gala, 20:00 coding starts; Saturday 12:00 pitching workshop; Sunday 15:30 closing gala.
- Place: Warsaw, Poland. The exact venue will be announced before applications open.
- Who: 100 places for Polish students and recent graduates of universities abroad, mainly computer science, AI/ML, engineering and data science. Apply solo or as a team.
- Cost: free.
- Language: Polish; some workshops and materials may be in English.
- Tracks: AI for people, AI in business and AI in government (partner tracks), plus an open track for a partner's own challenge.
- Applications: opening soon; the form will appear on the website.
- Partners: four packages (Title Sponsor, Track Partner, Supporting Partner, Patron). Contact: maks.rokosz@globalpolsoc.com

- [Global Polish Student Society](https://globalpolsoc.com): network of Polish students abroad
